assertions.name: saddle_actions_computed_and_jet_exactness_exclusion
assertions.source: 3 reciprocal pairs; quadrature converged; n=0 residues reproduce Step-1 {0, ±5i/16}; jets n=1..4 have identically zero residues on every sheet — the exactness (b)-invariant: d(X^(n−1)) has no periods/residues, so the classical-jet rule cannot yield the nonzero lw tower.

description: Lever-1 (z2bn): (A) the three reciprocal-pair saddle actions of the q-free color cubic, continuity-tracked quadrature (conv <1e-3): the exact-WKB dictionary puts Borel singularities at ACTIONS between branch points, not at branch positions (corrects the external dialog's conflation); values reported against the measured level-1/2 datum 1/sqrt2 with NO identification asserted (numerology guard). (B) exact sympy: sheet expansions at infinity reproduce the Step-1 n=0 residues {0, +-5i/16} (sheet-sum 0), and the 1/z coefficient of X^(n) vanishes identically for n=1..4 on every sheet — the finite face of the EXACTNESS (b)-exclusion: lambda_SW^(n)=X^(n)dz=d(X^(n-1)) is exact for n>=1, so all residues and all closed-cycle periods vanish; the classical-jet rule cannot carry a_D^(n)=lw(n-1)!=0 (invariant: Stokes/exactness; independent of #2768's q-freeness exclusion; q-difference route and prop:sw-period-residue-sum untouched). No fit; no wiring.
